power.answer: flydubai allows one power bank per passenger, of 100 Wh or less with the rating clearly marked. It must be in hand baggage only, switched off, protected from short circuits, never in an overhead locker, never in checked baggage, and not used on board.

sections.h: 🔋 What flydubai says about power banks
sections.p: From the flydubai Dangerous goods page, section "Power banks", read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
flydubai rule
rows: Only one power bank per passenger
100 Wh or less, clearly marked (labelled, embossed or printed) on the device; over 100 Wh strictly prohibited
Any power bank, portable charger, battery pack, pocket charger or power station whose main job is portable power
Switched off and protected from short circuits and accidental activation; original retail packaging or a pouch is advisable
Use is strictly prohibited, including charging devices or the power bank from aircraft sockets
In hand baggage under the seat or in the seat pocket; not in overhead lockers
Can lead to denial of carriage
The MOBIKINS MK-PB-04 power bank is prohibited in hand baggage, checked baggage and cargo

list: Not on the page: the same page separately allows up to 20 spare lithium batteries per passenger in hand baggage, but says power banks follow the power bank section.

faq: How many power banks can I take on flydubai?
Only one per passenger, of 100 Wh or less, in hand baggage.
Can I charge my phone from a power bank on flydubai?
No. Using a power bank on board is strictly prohibited, including charging devices or charging the power bank from aircraft sockets.
